about: End-to-end prompts for agent runs of the skill (skill-creator format). Run them with a signed-in browser; grade with the assertions. The deterministic back-test lives in vet_cases.json and ats_years_cases.json (run_evals.py).

evals.expected_output: Asks once whether to apply or only search (a bare slash command authorizes nothing), then searches LinkedIn, Indeed and Dice for the 72-hour window, vets with vet.py, applies only after the answer, writes rows to the tracker database and reports.
assertions: Asks a single AskUserQuestion covering apply-vs-search before any submission
Loads all Chrome tools in one ToolSearch call
Runs the bundled scripts from the skill folder
Reads the tracker's jobs collection and skips links already present
Runs vet.py in card mode before opening job pages
Every submitted application has 'Application sent' or an equivalent confirmation in the transcript
Overwrites prefilled years with the profile's verified_years values
Writes new rows with ArtifactData batch rather than republishing the tracker page
Records a runs/<date> document listing portals not searched
Final report names the applications, the Review items and what was not searched
Writes tracker rows after each portal and right after each application, not only at the end
Every row written, hand-built ones included, passed tracker.py check (no category outside the list)
Sets meta/criteria from tracker.py criteria once in the run
No javascript_tool result in the transcript is cut off with [TRUNCATED] for a snippet the skill ships

evals.prompt: apply to java jobs posted today, remote or chicago, and also do the company site ones I queued on the tracker
evals.expected_output: Uses a 24-hour window, applies to High/Medium Easy Apply jobs, then handles Queued company-site jobs: asks for domain access once, applies only on guest-form ATSs, and leaves account-walled ones in Review.
assertions: Uses f_TPR=r86400 (24 hours) on LinkedIn and fromage=1 on Indeed
Queries jobs where status == Queued before searching
Runs ats.py on each Queued apply URL
Asks for domain access for all company-site hosts in one message
Runs form_scan.js before filling any company-site form
Does not create an account or type a password on any site
Sets appliedBy to 'claude' on company-site jobs it submitted
Leaves Workday, iCIMS or Taleo jobs in Review with 'account required'

evals.prompt: can you just search and tell me what's out there this week, don't apply to anything
evals.expected_output: Search and vet only: a 7-day window (or the profile window with a note), tracker rows written as New or Review, no submissions.
assertions: No application is submitted
New qualifying rows are written with status New, not Applied
Report lists the High and Medium jobs with links

evals.prompt: The job in Needs you that wants entertainment-industry experience: Apply anyway, I'm fine with answering 0.
evals.expected_output: Applies to the Review row, answers the entertainment question with 0 and every other question from the profile, and updates the row to Applied.
assertions: Answers the entertainment-industry question with 0
Updates that job's tracker row to Applied with if_version from a fresh read
Does not change any other row

evals.prompt: apply to the good fits. Also apply the Uline posting
evals.expected_output: Applies to Queued rows first (an Easy Apply needs-call row the user queued included), asks once for any screening answer the profile lacks and asks again if the reply carries no value, then follows Uline's Apply link to its final host, finds Workday, and leaves it with the user with an updated Review row instead of creating an account.
assertions: Applies to the Queued Easy Apply row before searching
Asks for a missing screening figure (for example production-support years) instead of guessing, and re-asks when the answer has no number
Clicks through the careers page and classifies the final application host (myworkdayjobs.com) as Workday
Does not create an account or type a password even when the user asks; offers an answer sheet instead
Sets ats Workday, claudeCanApply false and applyUrl on the Uline row
